<font size="5">【最容易被忽略的<font face="inherit">隐藏福利</font>】</font><blockquote><font size="5">根据《中华人民共和国发票管理办法》，消费者有权要求商家补开发票。部分电商平台（如淘宝、京东、美团）支持<font face="inherit">跨年度订单合并开具一张发票</font>。</font></blockquote><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="inherit"><font size="5">如果你过去几年有多笔小额订单（比如外卖、买菜），单独开票都不满100元，但</font></font></font><font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="inherit"><font size="5"><strong>合并开票</strong></font></font></font><font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="inherit"><font size="5">就能参与抽奖！</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="inherit"><font size="5">以小象超市为例，今日多个平台中50*1+10*若干</font></font></font><br>
<img id="aimg_HDAD1" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" width="1079" height="1126" file="https://youke.xn--y7xa690gmna.cn/s1/2026/02/15/6991cf20da8ae.webp" border="0" alt="" src="https://youke.xn--y7xa690gmna.cn/s1/2026/02/15/6991cf20da8ae.webp"><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="inherit"><font size="5">【100以内加法算账脚本</font></font></font><img src="https://static.52pojie.cn/static/image/smiley/default/46.gif" smilieid="925" border="0" alt=""><font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="inherit"><font size="5">】输入数量和单笔金额</font></font></font><font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;"><font size="5">每次找刚好≥100、最接近100的组合，减少浪费。</font></font></font><br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Python] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: python; gutter: true">#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
有奖发票凑单工具
自动将订单组合成≥100元的发票，最大化奖券数量
"""

from itertools import combinations


def find_best_group(amounts, target=100):
    """找最接近target的组合"""
    n = len(amounts)
    best_idx = None
    min_waste = float('inf')
    
    # 尝试1-5个数的组合
    for r in range(1, min(n, 5) + 1):
        for combo in combinations(range(n), r):
            s = sum(amounts[i] for i in combo)
            if s &gt;= target and s - target &lt; min_waste:
                min_waste = s - target
                best_idx = combo
    
    if best_idx is None:
        return None, 0, amounts
    
    group = [amounts[i] for i in best_idx]
    remaining = [amounts[i] for i in range(n) if i not in best_idx]
    return group, sum(group), remaining


def optimize_orders(amounts, target=100):
    """主函数：最大化奖券数量"""
    remaining = sorted(amounts, reverse=True)
    result = []
    
    while remaining:
        group, total, remaining = find_best_group(remaining, target)
        if group is None:
            break
        result.append((group, total))
    
    # 按浪费排序
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    return result


# ========== 使用示例 ==========

# 你的订单金额（从淘宝/京东/美团导出）
orders = [
    60.11, 39.90, 48.25, 54.70, 65.27, 39.04, 
    89.05, 30.40, 81.07, 30.69, 1.99, 37.03,
    30.40, 64.08, 38.56, 39.09, 39.34, 39.35,
    39.58, 39.79, 44.80, 45.21
]

print(f"共{len(orders)}笔订单，总额{sum(orders):.2f}元\n")

groups = optimize_orders(orders)

print(f"可开{len(groups)}张奖券：\n")
for i, (g, total) in enumerate(groups, 1):
    waste = total - 100
    print(f"发票{i}：{' + '.join(f'{x:.2f}' for x in g)} = {total:.2f}元 (浪费{waste:.2f})")

# 导出清单
print(f"\n{'='*50}")
print("操作步骤：")
print("1. 登录淘宝/京东/美团")
print("2. 找到以上订单，勾选合并开票")
print("3. 每张发票开完参与抽奖")</pre></div><br>

<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Python] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: python; gutter: true">共22笔订单，总额967.30元

可开8张奖券：

发票1：60.11 + 39.90 = 100.01元 (浪费0.01)
发票2：1.99 + 30.69 + 37.03 + 30.40 = 100.11元 (浪费0.11)
发票3：64.08 + 38.56 = 102.64元 (浪费2.64)
发票4：48.25 + 54.70 = 102.95元 (浪费2.95)
发票5：65.27 + 39.04 = 104.31元 (浪费4.31)
发票6：39.09 + 39.34 + 39.35 = 117.78元 (浪费17.78)
发票7：81.07 + 39.58 = 120.65元 (浪费20.65)
发票8：89.05 + 39.79 = 128.84元 (浪费28.84)

剩余：44.80 + 45.21 = 90.01元（不够100，放弃或再凑一单）</pre></div><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;"><font size="5">【注意事项】</font></font></font><br>
<ul type="1" class="litype_1"><li><font size="5"><font face="inherit">真实消费才能开票</font>，别为了抽奖虚假交易</font></li><li><font size="5"><font face="inherit">奖金要交税</font>，偶然所得20%个税（部分地区自动扣）</font></li><li><font size="5"><font face="inherit">活动有地区限制</font>，广东、上海、北京等地规则不同，先看当地税务局公告</font></li><li><font size="5"><font face="inherit">别频繁操作</font>，合并开票次数太多可能引起平台风控</font><br>
</li></ul></td></tr></tbody></table>
